# Distance Based Measures of Spatial Structures

dbmss is an R package for simple computation of spatial statistic
functions of distance to characterize the spatial structures of mapped
objects, including classical ones (Ripley’s *K* and others) and more
recent ones used by spatial economists (Duranton and Overman’s *Kd*,
Marcon and Puech’s *M*). It relies on spatstat for some core
calculation.

## Installation

You can install the current release of the package from CRAN or the
development version of dbmss from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("EricMarcon/dbmss")
```

## Main functions

The main functions of the package are designed to calculate
distance-based measures of spatial structure. Those are non-parametric
statistics able to summarize and test the spatial distribution
(concentration, dispersion) of points.

The classical, topographic functions such as Ripley’s *K* are provided
by the *spatstat* package and supported by *dbmss* for convenience.

Relative functions are available in *dbmss* only. These are the $`M`$
and $`m`$ and $`K_d`$ functions.

The bivariate $`M`$ function can be calculated for *Q. Rosea* trees
around *V. Americana* trees:

``` r

library(dbmss)
autoplot(
  Mhat(
    paracou16, 
    ReferenceType = "V. Americana", 
    NeighborType = "Q. Rosea"
  ), 
  main = ""
)
```

![](reference/figures/README-m-1.png)

## Confidence envelopes

Confidence envelopes of various null hypotheses can be calculated. The
univariate distribution of *Q. Rosea* is tested against the null
hypothesis of random location.

``` r

autoplot(
  KdEnvelope(paracou16, ReferenceType = "Q. Rosea", Global = TRUE), 
  main = ""
)
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-2-1.png)

Significant concentration is detected between about 10 and 20 meters.

## Maps

Individual values of some distance-based measures can be computed and
mapped.

``` r

# Calculate individual intertype M(distance) value
ReferenceType <- "V. Americana"
NeighborType <- "Q. Rosea"
fvind <- Mhat(
  paracou16, 
  r = c(0, 30), 
  ReferenceType = ReferenceType, 
  NeighborType = NeighborType, 
  Individual = TRUE
)
# Plot the point pattern with values of M(30 meters)
p16_map <- Smooth(
  paracou16, 
  fvind = fvind, 
  distance = 30,
  # Resolution
  Nbx = 512, 
  Nby = 512
)
par(mar = rep(0, 4))
plot(p16_map, main = "")
# Add the reference points to the plot
is.ReferenceType <- marks(paracou16)$PointType == ReferenceType
points(
  x = paracou16$x[is.ReferenceType], 
  y = paracou16$y[is.ReferenceType], 
  pch = 20
)
# Add contour lines
contour(p16_map, nlevels = 5, add = TRUE)
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-3-1.png)

## Vignettes

A quick [introduction](https://EricMarcon.github.io/dbmss/) is in
[`vignette("dbmss")`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/articles/dbmss.md).

A [full
documentation](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/articles/articles/reference.html)
is available on the package website. It is a continuous update of the
paper published in the Journal of Statistical Software ([Marcon et al.,
2015](https://doi.org/10.18637/jss.v067.c03)).

## Reference

Marcon, E., Traissac, S., Puech, F. and Lang, G. (2015). Tools to
Characterize Point Patterns: dbmss for R. *Journal of Statistical
Software*. 67(3): 1-15.

# Package index

## Package summary

- [`dbmss-package`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/dbmss-package.md)
  [`dbmss`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/dbmss-package.md)
  : Distance Based Measures of Spatial Structures

## Datasets

Example datasets.

- [`paracou16`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/paracou16.md)
  : Paracou field station plot 16, partial map

## Prepare data

Data conversion and random generation.

- [`as.Dtable()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/as.Dtable.md)
  : Converts data to class Dtable
- [`as.wmppp()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/as.wmppp.md)
  : Converts data to class wmppp
- [`wmppp()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/wmppp.md) :
  Create a Weighted, Marked, Planar Point Pattern
- [`wmppp.object`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/wmppp.object.md)
  : Class of Weighted, Marked, Planar Point Patterns
- [`Dtable()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/Dtable.md) :
  Create a Distance table object.
- [`rPopulationIndependenceK()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/rPopulationIndependenceK.md)
  : Simulations of a point pattern according to the null hypothesis of
  population independence defined for K
- [`rPopulationIndependenceM()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/rPopulationIndependenceM.md)
  : Simulations of a point pattern according to the null hypothesis of
  population independence defined for M
- [`rRandomLabeling()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/rRandomLabeling.md)
  : Simulations of a point pattern according to the null hypothesis of
  random labeling
- [`rRandomLabelingM()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/rRandomLabelingM.md)
  : Simulations of a point pattern according to the null hypothesis of
  random labelling defined for M
- [`rRandomLocation()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/rRandomLocation.md)
  : Simulations of a point pattern according to the null hypothesis of
  random location
- [`rRandomPositionK()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/rRandomPositionK.md)
  : Simulations of a point pattern according to the null hypothesis of
  random position defined for K

## Distance-based functions

Non-parametric summary statistics of point patterns.

- [`Dhat()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/Dhat.md) :
  Estimation of the D function
- [`Kdhat()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/Kdhat.md) :
  Estimation of the Kd function
- [`Khat()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/Khat.md) :
  Estimation of the K function
- [`Kinhomhat()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/Kinhomhat.md)
  : Estimation of the inhomogenous K function
- [`Kmmhat()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/Kmmhat.md) :
  Estimation of the Kmm function
- [`Lhat()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/Lhat.md) :
  Estimation of the L function
- [`Lmmhat()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/Lmmhat.md) :
  Estimation of the Lmm function
- [`Mhat()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/Mhat.md) :
  Estimation of the M function
- [`ghat()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/ghat.md) :
  Estimation of the g function
- [`mhat()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/m_hat.md) :
  Estimation of the m function

## Confidence envelopes

Confidence envelopes for the non-parametric summary statistics of point
patterns.

- [`DEnvelope()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/DEnvelope.md)
  : Estimation of the confidence envelope of the D function under its
  null hypothesis
- [`KEnvelope()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/KEnvelope.md)
  : Estimation of the confidence envelope of the K function under its
  null hypothesis
- [`KdEnvelope()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/KdEnvelope.md)
  : Estimation of the confidence envelope of the Kd function under its
  null hypothesis
- [`KinhomEnvelope()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/KinhomEnvelope.md)
  : Estimation of the confidence envelope of the Kinhom function under
  its null hypothesis
- [`KmmEnvelope()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/KmmEnvelope.md)
  : Estimation of the confidence envelope of the Lmm function under its
  null hypothesis
- [`LEnvelope()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/LEnvelope.md)
  : Estimation of the confidence envelope of the L function under its
  null hypothesis
- [`LmmEnvelope()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/LmmEnvelope.md)
  : Estimation of the confidence envelope of the Lmm function under its
  null hypothesis
- [`MEnvelope()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/MEnvelope.md)
  : Estimation of the confidence envelope of the M function under its
  null hypothesis
- [`gEnvelope()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/gEnvelope.md)
  : Estimation of the confidence envelope of the g function under its
  null hypothesis
- [`mEnvelope()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/m_Envelope.md)
  : Estimation of the confidence envelope of the m function under its
  null hypothesis
- [`print(`*`<dbmssEnvelope>`*`)`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/print.dbmssEnvelope.md)
  : Print a confidence envelope
- [`summary(`*`<dbmssEnvelope>`*`)`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/summary.dbmssEnvelope.md)
  : Summary of a confidence envelope

## Tests

Statistical tests.

- [`GoFtest()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/GoFtest.md)
  : Goodness of Fit test between a distance based measure of spatial
  structure and simulations of its null hypothesis
- [`Ktest()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/Ktest.md) :
  Test of a point pattern against Complete Spatial Randomness

## Utilities

- [`dbmssEnvelope.object`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/dbmssEnvelope.md)
  : Class of envelope of function values (fv)
- [`autoplot(`*`<envelope>`*`)`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/autoplot.md)
  [`autoplot(`*`<fv>`*`)`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/autoplot.md)
  [`autoplot(`*`<wmppp>`*`)`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/autoplot.md)
  : ggplot methods to plot dbmss objects
- [`envelope(`*`<Dtable>`*`)`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/envelope.Dtable.md)
  : Computes simulation envelopes of a summary function.
- [`Smooth(`*`<wmppp>`*`)`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/Smooth.wmppp.md)
  : Spatial smoothing of individual dbmss's
- [`as.wmppp()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/as.wmppp.md)
  : Converts data to class wmppp
- [`sharpen(`*`<wmppp>`*`)`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/generic.spatstat.md)
  [`superimpose(`*`<wmppp>`*`)`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/generic.spatstat.md)
  [`unique(`*`<wmppp>`*`)`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/generic.spatstat.md)
  [`` `[`( ``*`<wmppp>`*`)`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/generic.spatstat.md)
  : Methods for weighted, marked planar point patterns (of class wmppp)
  from spatstat
- [`is.wmppp()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/is.wmppp.md)
  : Test whether an object is a weighted, marked, planar point pattern
- [`marks(`*`<Dtable>`*`)`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/marks.md)
  [`` `marks<-`( ``*`<Dtable>`*`)`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/marks.md)
  [`` `marks<-`( ``*`<wmppp>`*`)`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/dbmss/reference/marks.md)
  : marks method for Dtable and wmppp objects
